AncientGranaries
Factsto Know
Shaduf is a hand-operated device for lifting water, invented in ancient times and still
used in India, Egypt, and some other countries to irrigate land.
Granaries: Since ancient times, grain has been stored in bulk. As early as 8500 BC,
buildings known as granaries were used to house the cereal crops harvested by
settlements. These structures were used to protect grains, such as wheat and barley,
from rodents and insects.
EverydayLife ofanAncient Egyptian
In ancient Egypt men were the heads of families,
and their wives were in charge of the household
and the education of the children.Men had more
rights than women in most other early civilizations.
Egyptian women could own and pass on property.
Some women had their own businesses. Egyptians
used to wear loose white linen clothing due to hot
climate. The common man was very interested in hunting, fighting games, races, and
battles. Egyptians loved music and played harps, flutes, and drums.
EgyptianCraftsman
The craftsmen in ancient Egypt were usually trained
and skilled laborers. They had fine tools made .of
copperand bronze.
